thread:
Maya K: Quick note: partners keep asking for a single artifact they can validate. We should standardize a partner-bundle for ref-arch + terraform modules.
Jules F: Agree. Minimal bundle: module code, example workspace, metadata.json, migration.md, quickstart.sh, and a compatibility CSV.
Anika R: metadata.json should include providers, tf_versions, example_deploy, checksum, signature_url, and a small cost_estimate field.
Sam W: CI idea: GH Actions matrix per cloud -> smoke deploy to tiny test account via OIDC -> collect outputs -> package bundle -> sign with KMS -> upload to partner S3.
marketplace-bot: Note: AWS listings require CloudFormation or container/AMI packaging; GCP needs Cloud Build metadata; Azure needs ARM or managed app package.
Maya K: naming: redwood-partner/<cloud>/v{semver}-bundle.zip. Add a badge file compatibility_badge.svg inside bundle.
Jules F: Include an explicit "do not use in prod" flag for partner-beta bundles and document upgrade paths in migration.md.
Anika R: produce a compat CSV artifact with columns: cloud, provider_version, tf_version, instance_types_tested, gpu_support. Publish it alongside the bundle.
Sam W: owners: Jules (packaging + signing), Anika (examples + migration doc), Maya (partner comms). Target: AWS prototype in 5 business days.
Maya K: I'll schedule a 20-minute demo for partners after prototype. market-bot: please remind to attach publisher agreements before submission.
marketplace-bot: Reminder noted.
Maya K: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
